Name: Crafting Collections Page
Author: Gurm0
Description:
[size=5]Features[/size]

[list]
[*]See what items you have crafted, and how many!
[*]Track progress again all crafting recipes in the game, not just the recipes you have!
[/list]
[size=5]Installation[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Download Crafting Collections Page.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the downloaded file into the game's Mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
To uninstall, simply delete [b]CraftingCollection[/b] from your Mods folder.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and other mods that impact the crafting perfection score.[/size]
[*][size=2]Only compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and later.[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0.0+
